items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wanted to ask you about Fats Domino, did you ever play with him? No, no, Fats Domino.

ctx.x: and we went through Atlanta. Augusta, I was out there, I stood in Augusta about 18 months.
I wanted to ask you about Fats Domino, did you ever play with him? No, no, Fats Domino.
